selected_evidence.requirement: `/srv/drop` is shared writable and users cannot remove files owned by other users
selected_evidence.summary: Shows root:root ownership, mode 1777, successful writes by `nobody` and `daemon`, denied cross-owner deletions, and successful owner deletions.
Captures the healthy baseline and original boot ID, reboot acknowledgment, changed boot ID, matching persistent-data hash, restored mode 1777, and post-restart sticky-directory behavior.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
id
stat -c 'path=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a type=%F' /srv/drop 2>/dev/null || printf 'path=/srv/drop state=absent\n'
getent passwd | awk -F: '$3 >= 1000 && $3 < 65534 {print $1 ":" $3 ":" $6}'
commands.stdout:
node=node1 ip=10.100.158.10
uid=1000(antrieb) gid=1000(antrieb) groups=1000(antrieb)
path=/srv/drop state=absent
antrieb:1000:/home/antrieb

commands.command:
set -eu
sudo -n install -d -o root -g root -m 1777 /srv/drop
stat -c 'path=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a perms=%A type=%F' /srv/drop
commands.stdout: path=/srv/drop owner=root group=root mode=1777 perms=drwxrwxrwt type=directory

commands.command:
set -eu
sudo -u nobody sh -c 'printf "%s\n" nobody-data > /srv/drop/nobody-owned'
sudo -u daemon sh -c 'printf "%s\n" daemon-data > /srv/drop/daemon-owned'
stat -c 'file=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a' /srv/drop/nobody-owned /srv/drop/daemon-owned
if sudo -u nobody rm /srv/drop/daemon-owned 2>/tmp/drop-deny-1.err; then printf 'ERROR: nobody removed daemon-owned\n'; exit 1; else printf 'PASS: nobody denied removing daemon-owned: '; tr '\n' ' ' </tmp/drop-deny-1.err; printf '\n'; fi
if sudo -u daemon rm /srv/drop/nobody-owned 2>/tmp/drop-deny-2.err; then printf 'ERROR: daemon removed nobody-owned\n'; exit 1; else printf 'PASS: daemon denied removing nobody-owned: '; tr '\n' ' ' </tmp/drop-deny-2.err; printf '\n'; fi
sudo -u nobody rm /srv/drop/nobody-owned
sudo -u daemon rm /srv/drop/daemon-owned
printf 'PASS: each user could remove its own file; remaining entries='; find /srv/drop -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -printf '%f ' | sort; printf '\n'
stat -c 'path=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a perms=%A' /srv/drop
commands.stdout:
file=/srv/drop/nobody-owned owner=nobody group=nogroup mode=644
file=/srv/drop/daemon-owned owner=daemon group=daemon mode=644
PASS: nobody denied removing daemon-owned: rm: cannot remove '/srv/drop/daemon-owned': Operation not permitted 
PASS: daemon denied removing nobody-owned: rm: cannot remove '/srv/drop/nobody-owned': Operation not permitted 
PASS: each user could remove its own file; remaining entries=
path=/srv/drop owner=root group=root mode=1777 perms=drwxrwxrwt

commands.command:
set -eu
printf '%s\n' 'drop-directory restart persistence marker' > /srv/drop/.restart-persistence-check
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
stat -c 'dir=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a perms=%A' /srv/drop
stat -c 'marker=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a size=%s' /srv/drop/.restart-persistence-check
printf 'marker_sha256='; sha256sum /srv/drop/.restart-persistence-check | awk '{print $1}'
printf 'marker_content='; cat /srv/drop/.restart-persistence-check
printf 'filesystem='; findmnt -n -o SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS --target /srv/drop
commands.stdout:
boot_id=0256e3f5-9f2d-48f3-b55b-12f9f4d599ab
dir=/srv/drop owner=root group=root mode=1777 perms=drwxrwxrwt
marker=/srv/drop/.restart-persistence-check owner=antrieb group=antrieb mode=664 size=42
marker_sha256=e71ba22de8af3e3a4feb95228c3ccb66a0f9c9e92dd837340c7fb2a37000255f
marker_content=drop-directory restart persistence marker
